name: Terraform tooling
access: Reads infrastructure configuration; enabling an MCP may also allow cloud or state access.

name: PostgreSQL MCP
access: Can read or modify databases using the credentials supplied to the server.

name: Kafka tooling
access: May inspect or publish messages using locally configured broker credentials.

name: Kubernetes tooling
access: May inspect or modify resources in the active cluster context.

name: AWS tooling
access: May access AWS APIs using local or configured credentials.

name: Container tooling
access: May build images or control the local container daemon.

name: Stripe tooling
access: May access payment data or perform API operations with supplied credentials.

name: GitHub tooling
access: May read or change repositories, issues, pull requests, or workflows.
